source: Explicit Q1-Q14 replies and implementation authorization in this conversation
status: approved; implementation and strict acceptance in progress

decisions.question: Q1
decisions.decision: All applicable non-IDE, non-cloud-task capabilities are mandatory in this delivery; implementation batches do not defer scope.

decisions.question: Q2
decisions.decision: Latest commentary/current activity by default, with access to the entire process.

decisions.question: Q3
decisions.decision: Shared navigation/drafts/history/recovery/performance covers Codex, Claude and ACP; preserve provider-specific semantics.

decisions.question: Q4
decisions.decision: Keep existing model calls, login, MCP/plugins, feedback and dictation client capabilities; exclude cloud tasks/workspaces and server implementation.

decisions.question: Q5/Q8
decisions.decision: Warm recent pages for all followed conversations when resources permit; focused before visible before background; reclaim under resource pressure; older history on demand.

decisions.question: Q6
decisions.decision: Tab closure only removes following; ordinary archive and explicit stop-and-archive are distinct.

decisions.question: Q9
decisions.decision: Stop-and-archive pauses queue and active Goal, stops the exact current turn, preserves content/drafts and requires explicit continuation after recovery; unknown receipts reconciled first; no additional family stop.

decisions.question: Q7
decisions.decision: Pins and read/unread sync across devices; selection/layout/reading position/unsent drafts remain local; preload does not mark read.

decisions.question: Q10
decisions.decision: Normal LAN: 30 followed, 4 visible desktop panes, 3 browser pages; navigation/exact target/composer p95 <=2s with at least30 samples and maximum reported; uncached/slow history separately measured;50/100 stress without product count limit.

decisions.question: Q11
decisions.decision: Share the same live official service and real task interaction with CLI; sharing only history files is insufficient.

decisions.question: Q12
decisions.decision: Kanban may run official daemon start on demand, with no private app-server fallback or automatic shared-daemon restart/update/stop.

decisions.question: Q13
decisions.decision: This delivery shares Kanban and CLI; VS Code startup adaptation is out of scope.

decisions.question: Q14
decisions.decision: Use the official queue and thread settings; warn about changes affecting queued messages and explicitly migrate legacy frozen settings.
